## Summary

Describe the user-visible result and the boundary changed.

## Validation

- [ ] Focused tests: `command` → result
- [ ] Full `swift test`: result
- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] App bundle built and launched when applicable
- [ ] Fixture and real-window evidence attached for UI changes
- [ ] Manual macOS boundaries completed or listed below

## Privacy and security

- [ ] Data, permissions, network, logging, and deletion behavior reviewed
- [ ] Examples, fixtures, logs, and screenshots use synthetic data
- [ ] No credentials, Team IDs, certificate details, personal paths, or build artifacts are included

## Licensing and provenance

- [ ] New dependencies, fonts, and assets include source and license records
- [ ] Documentation and release notes are updated
- [ ] Generated content and tools used to create it are disclosed

## Not verified

List microphone, TCC, Accessibility, global shortcut, cross-app delivery, multi-display,
or signing checks that still need the target Mac.
